column1: # Test: Rapid short-scale speed bursts. Toggle GO/STOP every 500ms -- faster than the
#       trike can fully slew -- so the actual speed makes partial climbs and dips. Each
#       toggle must redirect the actual speed toward the newest command (chasing it)
#       then a final sustained GO must climb to cruise. Checks no stuck offset
# Physics: each 500ms GO burst reaches ~30 cm/s; each STOP burst falls back toward 0.
# NOTE: thresholds are conservative; tune after the first run if the ramp differs.
